name: config-generate-key-validation
title: Validate --config generate keys symmetric with server keys
description: _load_serve_config rejected unknown top-level 'server' keys but passed the 'generate' map through with only a type check, so a typo'd generate key was silently ignored or mismapped instead of failing loud like a server-key typo. Landed as parser-backed validation of both sections rather than a second hand-maintained allowlist, plus the defects review surfaced along the way: null/false keys vouched against the real parser, non-string YAML keys, dash-prefixed values, generate keys that name serve flags, unattributed load refusals, and a no-config-values-in-errors rule for every refusal. The --config cluster moved to the server_config.py leaf to pay for the growth. See prd.md 'Scope As Landed'.
creator: sdelmas
